# Slimzol

> An independently published guide to Slimzol, a liquid weight loss support dietary supplement sold in a 1 Fl Oz (30 mL) dropper bottle of 30 servings. Written for readers in the United States at https://slimzol-usa.vercel.app/. Orders complete on the company's own checkout. Last reviewed 13 November 2026.

Each 1 mL dropperful of Slimzol carries 7 mcg of chromium as chromium picolinate (20% of the Daily Value) and a 15.47 mg proprietary blend of 21 ingredients. This page groups that blend by what each part is: four adaptogenic roots (maca, eleuthero, astragalus, Panax ginseng), four warming or stimulant botanicals (guarana, green tea, cayenne, Coleus forskohlii), four fruit and taste botanicals (Gymnema, African mango, grape seed, grapefruit seed), nine amino acids and related compounds, and the one trace mineral. The liquid base is water, natural flavors, potassium sorbate, stevia, xylitol and citrus extract. Suggested use is one dropperful daily, shaken first, placed in the mouth and swallowed. Cost runs from $1.63 to $2.63 a day depending on pack size, with a 60-day money-back guarantee. Sold to adults 18 and over.
